1: Ta Seen. Yeh Quran aur ek khuli kitab ki aayatein hain. Aise huroof ke baare mein baat Surah Al-Baqarah ke shuru mein ho chuki hai. Yeh aayatein jo aap par utari gayin, Quran aur ek khuli kitab ki aayatein hain jis mein koi uljhan nahin. Jo shaks is par gaur karega use maaloom ho jayega ke yeh Allah ki taraf se hai.
2: Yeh aayatein haqq ki hidayat deti hain aur us ki taraf rehnumai karti hain, aur un logon ko khush-khabri deti hain jo Allah aur Us ke rasoolon par iman laate hain.
3: Woh log jo namaz sab se mukammal tareeqe se qayam karte hain aur apne maal ki zakaat us ke haqdaaron par kharch karke dete hain, aur woh Aakhirat ke ajr aur saza par yaqeen rakhte hain.
4: Aur jo kafir Aakhirat par aur us mein milne wale ajr aur saza par iman nahin rakhte, Maine un ke bure aamaal unhein khoobsurat kar dikhaye, is liye woh unhein karte rahe, aur woh uljhan mein hain, na durusti ka raasta paate hain aur na hidayat ka.
5: Aise log duniya ki zindagi mein aazmaishon aur zillat ka saamna karenge, aur Aakhirat mein sab se bada ghaata uthayenge: Qayamat ke din apne aap ko aur apne ghar walon ko kho baithenge aur hamesha ke liye Jahannam mein daakhil honge.
6: Aey Rasool, aap ko yeh Quran mil raha hai jo aap par us Hasti ki taraf se utara ja raha hai jo apni takhleeq, apne intezam aur apni shariat mein Hikmat wala hai, aur Jaanne wala hai, jis se apne bandon ki bhalai ki koi baat chhipi nahin.
7: Aey Rasool, woh waqt yaad kijiye jab Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne apne ghar walon se kaha: 'Maine ek aag dekhi hai. Main us se koi khabar laaoonga, us shaks se jis ne use jalaya taake woh humein raasta dikhaye, ya main tumhare paas us mein se aag ka ek shola le aaoonga, is umeed par ke tum us se aag jalao aur sardi se garmi haasil karo.'
8: Phir jab woh us aag ki jagah pahunche jo unhon ne dekhi thi, to Allah ne unhein pukara ke woh jo aag mein hai aur woh farishte jo us ke aas-paas hain barkat wale hain.
9: Allah ne un se farmaya: 'Aey Moosa (alaihis salaam), Main hi Allah hoon, Ghalib jis par koi ghalib nahin aa sakta, aur apni takhleeq, apne intezam aur apni shariat mein Hikmat wala.
10: Aur apni laathi daal do.' Moosa (alaihis salaam) ne hukm maana. Phir jab Moosa ne use saanp ki tarah harkat karte aur hilte dekha to woh peeth pher kar bhaage aur peeche na mude. To Allah ne un se farmaya: 'Is se na daro. Mere saamne rasool na saanpon se darte hain aur na kisi aur cheez se.
11: Magar jo shaks gunah karke apni jaan par zulm kare, phir us ke baad tauba kar le, to Main us ke liye Bakhshne wala hoon, us par Meharban hoon.
12: Aur apna haath apne girebaan mein daal do; woh us mein daalne ke baad barf jaisa safed nikal aayega, kodh ki wajah se nahin, un nau nishaniyon ke ek hisse ke taur par jo tumhari sachhaai ki gawahi deti hain. Haath ke saath woh yeh hain: laathi, qeht, phalon ki kami, sailab, tiddiyan, joonein, mendhak aur khoon: Firaun aur us ki qaum ki taraf. Woh aise log the jo Allah ka inkaar karke Us ki itaat se nikal gaye the.'
13: Phir jab Meri yeh khuli aur saaf nishaniyan un ke paas aayin jin se Maine Moosa (alaihis salaam) ki madad ki, to unhon ne kaha: 'Yeh nishaniyan jo Moosa laaya hai khula jaadu hain.'
14: Aur unhon ne in mojizon ka inkaar kiya aur unhein na maana, is ke baawajood ke unhein yaqeen tha ke woh Allah ki taraf se hain, apne zulm aur haqq ke muqable mein apne gurur ki wajah se. Lihaza aey Rasool, gaur kijiye ke un logon ka kya anjaam hua jo zameen mein apne kufr aur apni nafarmani se fasaad machate the; Maine unhein halak kar diya aur un sab ko mita diya.
15: Aur Maine Dawood (alaihis salaam) aur un ke bete Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ko ilm diya, jis ka ek hissa parindon ki zubaan thi. Aur Dawood aur Sulaiman ne Allah ka shukr ada karte hue kaha: 'Tamam taarif Allah ke liye hai jis ne humein apne bahut se momin bandon par fazeelat di, nabuwwat ke zariye aur jinnon ko taabe karke.'
16: Aur Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) apne baap ke nabuwwat, ilm aur baadshahat ke waris bane, aur unhon ne apne aur apne baap par Allah ka ehsan bayan karte hue kaha: 'Aey logo, Allah ne humein parindon ki zubaan sikhayi aur humein har us cheez mein se diya jo Us ne nabiyon aur badshahon ko di. Yeh jo Us ne humein diya khula aur saaf fazl hai.'
17: Aur Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ke liye un ke insaano, jinnon aur parindon ke lashkar jama kiye gaye, aur unhein tarteeb se chalaya ja raha tha.
18: Unhein chalaya ja raha tha yahan tak ke jab woh cheentiyon ki waadi mein pahunche, jo Shaam mein ek jagah hai, to ek cheenti ne kaha: 'Aey cheentiyo, apne gharon mein ghus jao taake Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) aur un ke lashkar tumhein kuchal na dein jab ke woh tumhein jaante hi nahin, kyunke agar woh tumhein jaan lein to woh tumhein nahin kuchlenge.'
19: Jab Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ne use yeh kehte suna to woh us ki is baat par muskura diye aur apne Rubb ko pukarte hue kaha: 'Aey Rubb, mujhe taufeeq de aur mere dil mein daal ke main teri us naimat ka shukr ada karoon jo tu ne mujhe aur mere maa-baap ko di, aur mujhe aise neik kaam karne ki taufeeq de jo tujhe pasand hon, aur mujhe apne neik bandon mein daakhil kar le.'
20: Aur Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ne parindon ki haazri li magar hud-hud ko na dekha, to unhon ne kaha: 'Mujhe kya hua ke main hud-hud ko nahin dekh raha? Kya koi cheez use dekhne se mujhe rok rahi hai ya woh gaayab rehne walon mein se hai?'
21: Jab un par us ka gaayab hona wazeh ho gaya to unhon ne kaha: 'Main use sakht saza doonga, ya use zibah kar doonga, us ke gaayab rehne ki saza ke taur par, siwaye is ke ke woh apni gair-haazri ka uzr saabit karne ke liye koi khuli daleel le aaye.'
22: Hud-hud thodi der gaayab raha. Phir jab woh aaya to us ne Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) se kaha: 'Mujhe woh maaloom hua jo aap ko maaloom nahin, aur main aap ke paas Saba se ek sachchi khabar laaya hoon jis mein koi shak nahin.
23: Maine wahan ek aurat paayi jo un par hukumat karti hai, aur use har cheez mein se diya gaya hai, aur us ka ek bada takht hai. Maine ek aurat paayi jo un par hukumat karti hai, aur is aurat ko taaqat aur baadshahat ke tamam zariye diye gaye hain, aur us ka ek bada takht hai jis par woh apni qaum ke kaam chalati hai.
24: Maine use aur us ki qaum ko Allah ke siwa sooraj ko sajda karte paaya, aur shaytan ne un ke aamaal unhein khoobsurat kar dikhaye aur unhein Us ke raaste se hata diya, is liye woh hidayat nahin paate. Maine is aurat ko aur us ki qaum ko Allah ke siwa sooraj ko sajda karte paaya, aur shaytan ne un ke liye shirk aur gunah ke woh kaam khoobsurat kar dikhaye jin par woh hain, chunanche us ne unhein haqq ke raaste se pher diya, aur isi liye woh Us ki hidayat nahin paate.
25: Is liye woh Allah ko sajda nahin karte, jo aasmaano aur zameen ki chhipi cheezein nikaalta hai aur jaanta hai jo tum chhipate ho aur jo tum zaahir karte ho. Shaytan ne un ke liye shirk aur gunah ke un ke kaam khoobsurat kar dikhaye, taake woh sirf Allah ko sajda na karein, jo woh baarish laata hai jise Us ne aasmaano mein chhipa rakha hai aur woh podey jo zameen mein hain, aur Woh un aamaal ko jaanta hai jo tum chhipate ho aur jo tum zaahir karte ho, un mein se kuch Us se chhipa nahin.
26: Allah: Us ke siwa koi maabood nahin, Arsh-e-Azeem ka Rubb. Allah: Us ke siwa koi sachcha maabood nahin, Arsh-e-Azeem ka Rubb.'
27: Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Main dekhoonga ke tu sachcha hai ya tu jhooton mein se tha.' Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ne hud-hud se kaha: 'Main dekhoonga ke tu apne daawe mein sachcha hai ya tu jhooton mein se tha.'
28: Chunanche Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ne ek khat likha aur hud-hud ke hawale kiya, aur us se kaha: 'Mera yeh khat le ja, aur Saba walon ko de de aur un ke hawale kar de, aur un se ek taraf hat ja taake tu sun sake ke woh is ke baare mein kya baat karte hain.'
29: Malika ne kaha: 'Aey sardaro, beshak mujhe ek izzat wala khat pahunchaya gaya hai.' Malika ko khat mila aur us ne kaha: 'Aey sardaro, mujhe ek izzat wala aur shaandaar khat diya gaya hai.
30: Be-shak woh Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ki taraf se hai, aur be-shak us mein likha hai: Allah ke naam se jo Rehman aur Raheem hai.' Us khat ka mazmoon, jo Sulaiman ne bheja aur jo in lafzon se shuru hota hai, yeh hai:
31: 'Mujh par gurur na karo aur mere paas farmanbardaar ho kar aao.' Gurur na karo, aur mere paas itaat ke saath aur us baat ke saamne jhukte hue aao jis ki taraf main tumhein bulata hoon, yani Allah ke yakta hone ka iqrar aur us shirk ko chhodna jis mein tum pade ho, ke tum Us ke saath sooraj ki ibadat karte ho.
32: Malika ne kaha: 'Aey sardaro, mere maamle mein mujhe mashwara do. Main koi faisla karne wali nahin jab tak tum mere saamne gawahi na do.' Malika ne kaha: 'Aey sardaro aur bado, mere maamle mein mujhe durust raasta batao. Main koi faisla nahin karti jab tak tum mere paas aa kar apni raayein pesh na kar do.'
33: Us ki qaum ke sardaron ne kaha: 'Hum bari taaqat aur jang mein mazboot zor wale log hain, magar raaye wahi hai jo aap samjhein, lihaza dekh lijiye ke aap humein kya hukm dengi; hum use poora kar sakte hain.'
34: Malika ne kaha: 'Jab badshah kisi basti mein daakhil hote hain to use barbaad kar dete hain: qatl, qabza aur loot-maar karke; aur us ke sardaron aur bade logon ko zaleel kar dete hain, us izzat aur us hifazat ke baad jo unhein haasil thi. Aur badshah hamesha aisa hi karte hain jab woh kisi basti walon ko fatah karte hain, taake aam logon ke dilon mein khauf aur dehshat beth jaye.'
35: 'Aur main khat bhejne wale aur us ki qaum ke paas ek tohfa bhej rahi hoon, aur dekhoongi ke yeh tohfa bhejne ke baad bheje hue log kya le kar laute hain.'
36: Phir jab us ka qaasid aur us ke saath ke madadgaar Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ke paas tohfa le kar aaye, to unhon ne tohfa bhejne par unhein tokte hue kaha: 'Kya tum mujhe maal de rahe ho taake mujhe apne se pher do? Woh nabuwwat, woh baadshahat aur woh maal jo Allah ne mujhe diya us se behtar hai jo Us ne tumhein diya. Balke tum hi ho jo duniya ki un chand roza doulaton par khush ho rahe ho jo tumhein mili hain.'
37: Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ne us ke qaasid se kaha: 'Jo tohfa tum laaye ho use le kar un ke paas laut jao, kyunke hum us ke aur us ki qaum ke paas aise lashkar le kar aayenge jin ka saamna karne ki unhein taaqat nahin hogi, aur hum unhein Saba se zillat ke saath nikaal denge, us izzat ke baad jis mein woh the, agar woh mere paas farmanbardaar ho kar na aayein.'
38: Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ne apni baadshahat ke bade logon se khitaab karte hue kaha: 'Aey sardaro, tum mein se kaun us ka shahi takht mere paas laayega is se pehle ke woh mere paas farmanbardaar ho kar aayein?'
39: Ek sarkash jinn ne jawab mein kaha: 'Main us ka takht aap ke paas laa doonga is se pehle ke aap apni is majlis se uthein jis mein aap hain. Main use uthane ke liye kaafi taaqatwar hoon, aur us ke mazmoon par bharose ke laayak hoon, lihaza main us mein se kuch nahin loonga.'
40: Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ke paas maujood ek neik aur ilm wale shaks ne, jise kitab ka ilm tha jis ka ek hissa Allah ka woh sab se bada naam hai jis se dua ki jaye to Allah qabool karta hai, kaha: 'Main us ka takht aap ke paas laa doonga is se pehle ke aap ki palak jhapke, Allah se dua karke ke woh use laa de.' Chunanche us ne dua ki aur Allah ne us ki dua qabool kar li. Phir jab Sulaiman ne us ka takht apne saamne rakha dekha to unhon ne kaha: 'Yeh mere Rubb ke fazl se hai, taake woh mujhe aazmaye ke main Us ki naimaton ka shukr ada karta hoon ya na-shukri karta hoon. Aur jo shaks Allah ka shukr ada karta hai, us ke shukr ka faida usi ko lautega, kyunke Allah be-niyaz hai, kisi cheez ka mohtaaj nahin, Use apne bandon ke shukr se na koi faida hota hai aur na nuqsan. Aur jo shaks Allah ki naimaton ka inkaar kare aur un par Us ka shukr ada na kare, to mera Rubb be-niyaz hai, shukr ka mohtaaj nahin, aur bada Karam wala hai. Us ke karam ka ek hissa yeh hai ke Woh un logon ko bhi deta hai jo Us ka inkaar karte hain.'
41: Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Us ka shahi takht us ki asli shakl se badal do: hum dekhenge ke kya woh ise apna takht pehchanne ki hidayat paati hai ya woh un logon mein se hogi jo apni cheezein pehchanne ki hidayat nahin paate?'
42: Phir jab Saba ki malika Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ke paas aayi, to use aazmane ke liye us se kaha gaya: 'Kya tumhara takht aisa hi hai?' Us ne sawal ke mutabiq jawab diya: 'Yeh to aisa hi lagta hai.' Aur Allah ne humein us se pehle ilm de diya tha aur hum Allah ke hukm ke saamne jhukne wale aur Us ke farmanbardaar the.
43: Aur use Allah ke yakta hone se un cheezon ne pher diya jin ki woh Allah ke siwa ibadat karti thi, apni qaum ki pairvi aur un ki andhi taqleed mein. Aur woh un logon mein se thi jo Allah ka inkaar karte hain, lihaza woh un ki tarah kafir thi.
44: Us se kaha gaya: 'Mahal mein daakhil ho jao,' jo ek hamwaar satah jaisa tha. Jab woh us mein daakhil hui to us ne samjha ke yeh paani hai aur us mein daakhil hone ke liye apni pindliyan khol lein. Sulaiman (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Yeh ek mahal hai jise sheeshe se hamwaar kiya gaya hai.' Aur unhon ne use Islam ki taraf bulaya, to us ne woh baat qabool kar li jis ki taraf unhon ne bulaya aur kaha: 'Aey Rubb, maine tere siwa doosron ki ibadat karke apni jaan par zulm kiya, aur ab main Sulaiman ke saath Allah ke saamne jhuk gayi, jo tamam makhlooq ka Rubb hai.'
45: Aur Maine Samood ki taraf un ke nasab ke bhai Saleh (alaihis salaam) ko bheja aur kaha ke 'sirf Allah ki ibadat karo', magar un ke bulane ke baad woh do giroh ban gaye: ek momin giroh aur doosra kafir, jo is par jhagadte the ke haqq par kaun hai.
46: Saleh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Tum Allah ki rehmat talash karne ke bajaye azaab jald kyun maangte ho? Tum apne gunahon ke liye Allah se magfirat kyun nahin maangte, is umeed par ke Woh tumhein maaf kar de?'
47: Un ki qaum ne un se haqq ke muqable mein hath-dharmi se kaha: 'Hum tumhein aur tumhare saath ke mominon ko na-husi samajhte hain.' Saleh (alaihis salaam) ne kaha: 'Woh parinde jinhein tum uda kar us mushkil ko na-husi samajhte ho jo tumhein tumhari na-pasandeeda cheezon se pahunchti hai, woh haqeeqat mein Allah ka muqarrar kiya hua hai aur Use us ka ilm hai.'
48: Aur Hijr ke shehar mein nau aise mard the jo zameen mein kufr aur gunahon se fasaad machate the, aur us mein iman aur neik aamaal se koi islaah nahin karte the.
49: Unhon ne ek doosre se kaha: 'Tum mein se har ek Allah ki qasam khaye ke hum raat ko us ke aur us ke saath ke mominon ke paas jayenge, phir hum unhein qatl kar denge aur phir us shaks se kahenge jo un ke khoon ka badla lene ka zimmedaar hai: hum Saleh (alaihis salaam) ke qatl ya un ke pairokaaron ke qatl ke waqt maujood hi nahin the, aur hum apni is baat mein sachche hain.'
50: Aur unhon ne chhup kar Saleh (alaihis salaam) aur un ke momin pairokaaron ko halak karne ka mansooba banaya, aur Maine bhi un ki madad, unhein un ki saazish se bachane aur un ki qaum ke kafiron ko halak karne ka mansooba banaya, jab ke woh is se be-khabar the.
51: Lihaza aey Rasool, gaur kijiye ke un ki chaalon aur un ki saazishon ka kya anjaam aur kya natija nikla; kya woh apni manzil tak pahunche? Nahin. Balke Maine unhein apni taraf se ek azaab se jad se ukhaad diya aur woh sab halak ho gaye.
52: Aur yeh un ke ghar hain jin ki deewarein un ki chhaton par gir padin, aur woh rehne walon se khaali reh gaye, un ke zulm ki wajah se. Us azaab mein jo un par un ke zulm ki wajah se aaya, un logon ke liye sabaq hai jo iman rakhte hain, kyunke wahi log nishaniyon se sabaq lete hain.
53: Aur Maine Saleh (alaihis salaam) ki qaum mein se un logon ko bacha liya jo iman laaye, aur woh Allah se darte the, Us ke hukm par chalte the aur Us ki mana ki hui cheezon se bachte the.
54: Aey Rasool, Lut (alaihis salaam) ko yaad kijiye jab unhon ne apni qaum se kaha, unhein daantte aur un par tanqeed karte hue: 'Kya tum apni majlison mein be-haayi ka woh kaam karte ho, yani qaum-e-Lut ka amal, khule-aam ek doosre ko dekhte hue?
55: Kya tum shahwat ke liye mardon ke paas jate ho aur auraton ko chhod dete ho, na paakdaamani chahte ho aur na aulaad, balke sirf jaanwaron jaisi shahwat poori karte ho? Balke tum aise log ho jo us cheez se na-waaqif ho jo tum par laazim hai, yani iman, paaki aur gunahon se door rehna.'
56: Magar un ki qaum ke paas is baat ke siwa koi jawab na tha ke unhon ne kaha: 'Lut (alaihis salaam) ke ghar walon ko apni basti se nikaal do. Yeh aise log hain jo gandagi aur napaaki se paak rehna chahte hain.' Unhon ne yeh Lut ke ghar walon ka mazaaq udane ke liye kaha jo un ke saath un be-haayi ke kaamon mein shaamil nahin hote the jo woh karte the, balke un ke karne par unhein tokte the.
57: Chunanche Hum ne unhein aur un ke ghar walon ko bacha liya, siwaye un ki biwi ke, jis ke liye tai ho chuka tha ke woh un logon mein se hogi jo azaab ke liye peeche reh jayenge, taake woh un mein se ho jo halak kiye gaye.
58: Aur Maine Lut (alaihis salaam) ki qaum par pakki hui mitti ke paththar barsaye. Un logon par barasne wali woh baarish kitni bhayanak thi jinhein daraya gaya tha, jaise Lut ki qaum, jinhon ne un ki baat na maani balke apne kufr, apni gumraahi aur apni be-haayi par jame rahe.
59: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: 'Tamam taarif Allah ke liye hai Us ki naimaton par, aur Us ki taraf se salaam ho Us ke un rasoolon par jinhein Us ne apna deen pahunchane ke liye chuna.' Kya Allah behtar hai, jo sachcha maabood hai aur jis ke haath mein har cheez ki baadshahat hai, ya woh maabood jin ki mushrik ibadat karte hain, jo na faida rakhte hain aur na nuqsan?
60: Bhala kaun behtar hai, woh jis ne aasmaano aur zameen ko bina kisi pehli misaal ke paida kiya, aur aey logo, tumhare liye aasman se baarish ka paani utara, phir tumhare liye khoobsurati wale baagh ugaye? Tumhare bas mein nahin tha ke in baagon ke darakht ugate, kyunke tum yeh kar hi nahin sakte. Lihaza Allah hi ne unhein ugaya. Kya Allah ke saath koi sachcha maabood hai? Nahin, balke woh aise log hain jo haqq se munh modte hain, is liye woh na-haqq makhlooq ko Khaaliq ke barabar kar dete hain.
61: Bhala kaun behtar hai, woh jis ne zameen ko jama hua aur thehra hua banaya, bina is ke ke woh us par maujood logon ko hilaye, aur us mein behti hui nahrein banayin, aur us ke liye mazboot pahaad banaye, aur do samundaron ke darmiyan, khaare aur meethe ke, ek aad banayi jo khaare ko meethe se milne se rokti hai taake woh use kharaab na kar de aur woh peene ke laayak na rahe? Kya Allah ke saath koi sachcha maabood hai jo yeh sab kar sake? Nahin, magar un mein se aksar nahin jaante. Agar woh jaante to Allah ki kisi makhlooq ko Us ka sharik na thehrate.
62: Bhala kaun behtar hai, woh jo pareshan-haal ki pukar qabool karta hai jab woh Use pukarta hai aur apni takleef hatane ko kehta hai, aur jo us cheez ko hata deta hai jo insaan ko buri lagti hai, jaise beemari aur tangi, aur jo tumhein zameen mein janasheen banata hai, ke tum ek ke baad ek nasl aa kar us mein aate ho? Kya Allah ke saath koi sachcha maabood hai jo yeh sab kar sake? Nahin. Tum bahut kam nasihat lete aur gaur karte ho.
63: Bhala kaun behtar hai, woh jo tumhein khushki ke andheron aur samundar ke andheron mein un nishaniyon aur un sitaron se raasta dikhata hai jo Us ne tumhare liye muqarrar kiye, aur jo hawaein bhejta hai jo qareeb aati hui baarish ki khush-khabri deti hain aur jis se Woh apne bandon par reham karega? Kya Allah ke saath koi sachcha maabood hai jo yeh sab kar sake aur is ka faisla kare? Allah un sharikon se paak aur bahut door hai jo makhlooq Us ke saath thehrati hai.
64: Bhala kaun behtar hai, woh jo peton mein takhleeq ka aaghaz karta hai, ek darje ke baad doosra darja, phir use maut dene ke baad dobara zinda karega, aur jo tumhein aasman se us paani ki rozi deta hai jo us simt se utarta hai, aur jo tumhein zameen se un podon ki rozi deta hai jo Woh us mein ugaata hai? Kya Allah ke saath koi sachcha maabood hai jo yeh sab kar sake aur is ka faisla kare? Aey Rasool, in mushrikon se keh dijiye: 'Apne us shirk ki dalilein lao jis par tum ho, agar tum is daawe mein sachche ho ke tum haqq par ho.'
65: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: gaib ko na aasmaano ke farishte jaante hain aur na zameen ke log. Magar sirf Allah hi hai jo use jaanta hai. Aur aasmaano aur zameen mein Allah ke siwa koi nahin jaanta ke woh badle ke liye kab uthaye jayenge.
66: Balke un ka ilm Aakhirat mein poora ho jayega, kyunke woh use apni aankhon se dekh lenge, is ke baad ke rasool unhein us ki khabar dete the jab woh gaib tha, magar woh use jhutlate the kyunke unhon ne use dekha nahin tha. Aur woh apni duniya ki zindagi mein Aakhirat ke baare mein shak aur uljhan mein the, kyunke un ki aankhein aur un ke dil us ki taraf se andhe ho chuke the.
67: Aur jin logon ne kufr kiya unhon ne jhutlate hue kaha: 'Jab hum mar jayenge aur mitti ban jayenge, to kya yeh mumkin hai ke hum zinda uthaye jayenge?
68: Hum se aur is se pehle hamare bap-dada se wada kiya gaya ke hum sab uthaye jayenge, magar hum ne woh wada poora hote nahin dekha. Yeh wada jo hum sab se kiya gaya, pichle logon ke un jhooton ke siwa kuch nahin jo unhon ne apni kitabon mein likh liye.'
69: Aey Rasool, dobara zinda hone ko jhutlane walon se keh dijiye: 'Zameen mein jis taraf chaho chalo phiro, phir gaur karo ke un mujrimon ka kya anjaam hua jinhon ne dobara zinda hone ko jhutlaya; Maine unhein us ke jhutlane ki wajah se halak kar diya.'
70: Aur mushrikon ke aap ki daawat se munh modne par gam na kijiye, aur na aap ka seena tang ho aur na aap un ki us saazish par pareshan hon jo woh aap ke khilaaf karte hain, kyunke Allah aap ke saath hai aur Woh un ke khilaaf aap ki madad karega.
71: Aur aap ki qaum ke woh kafir jo dobara zinda hone ko jhutlate hain kehte hain: 'Woh azaab kab aayega jis ka tum aur momin hum se wada karte ho, agar tum apne is daawe mein sachche ho?'
72: Aey Rasool, un se keh dijiye: 'Ho sakta hai ke us azaab ka kuch hissa jise tum jald maang rahe ho pehle hi qareeb aa chuka ho.'
73: Aur aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb logon par bada fazl karne wala hai, ke Woh unhein jald saza nahin deta us kufr aur un gunahon ke baawajood jin par woh hain. Magar aksar log un naimaton par Allah ka shukr ada nahin karte jo Woh unhein deta hai.
74: Aur aap ka Rubb jaanta hai jo Us ke bandon ke dil chhipate hain aur jo woh zaahir karte hain. Un mein se kuch Us se chhipa nahin.
75: Aur aasman mein koi aisi cheez nahin jo logon se chhipi ho aur na zameen par koi aisi cheez hai jo un se chhipi ho, magar yeh ke woh ek khuli kitab mein hai, jo Lauh-e-Mehfooz hai.
76: Be-shak yeh Quran, jo Muhammad ﷺ par utara gaya, Bani Israel ko un ki aksar un baaton ki khabar deta hai jin mein woh ikhtilaaf karte hain, aur un ke bhatakne ko khol deta hai.
77: Aur yeh un mominon ke liye hidayat aur rehmat hai jo us ki laayi hui baat par amal karte hain.
78: Aey Rasool, aap ka Rubb Qayamat ke din logon ke darmiyan, mominon aur kafiron ke darmiyan, apne insaaf wale faisle se faisla karega. Woh momin par reham karega aur kafir ko azaab dega, aur Wohi Ghalib hai jo apne dushmanon se badla lega aur koi Us par ghalib nahin aa sakta, aur Jaanne wala hai jis par sachcha jhoote se chhipa nahin.
79: Lihaza Allah par bharosa rakhiye, aur apne tamam kaamon mein Usi par takiya kijiye. Aap khule haqq par hain.
80: Aey Rasool, aap un murdon ko nahin sunwa sakte jin ke dil Allah ke inkaar se mar chuke hain, aur na aap un logon ko woh baat sunwa sakte hain jis ki taraf aap unhein bulate hain, jinhon ne apni sunne ki taaqat kho di hai, jab woh peeth pher kar aap se munh moad kar jate hain.
81: Aur aap un logon ko hidayat dene wale nahin jin ki aankhein haqq se andhi hain, lihaza un par gam na kijiye aur apne aap ko na thakaiye. Aap ki pukar sirf woh log sunenge jo Hamari aayaton par iman rakhte hain, kyunke woh Allah ke ahkaam ke saamne jhuk jate hain.
82: Aur jab un par azaab laazim aur pakka ho jayega, un ke kufr aur un ke gunahon ki wajah se, aur sab se bure log baaqi reh jayenge, to Main un ke liye Qayamat ke qareeb us ki sab se bari nishaniyon mein se ek nishani nikaaloonga, yani zameen se ek jaanwar jo un se aisi baat karega jo woh samjhenge ke logon ne Meri un aayaton par iman nahin laaya jo Mere Nabi par utari gayin.
83: Aey Rasool, woh din yaad kijiye jab Main har ummat mein se un sardaron ka ek giroh jama karoonga jo Hamari aayaton ka inkaar karte the, taake woh apne pairokaaron se pehle Aag ki taraf jayein. Pehle giroh ko roka jayega yahan tak ke sardaron ka aakhiri giroh bhi jama ho jaye, aur phir unhein hisaab ki taraf le jaya jayega.
84: Aur unhein le jaya jata rahega yahan tak ke jab woh apne hisaab ki jagah par aa jayenge, to Allah unhein daantte hue farmayega: 'Kya tum ne Meri un nishaniyon ko jhutlaya jo Mere yakta hone ko saabit karti theen aur jin mein Meri shariat thi, jab ke tumhare paas koi durust ilm nahin tha ke unhein jhoota qarar do aur un ka inkaar karo; ya phir tum kya karte rahe: iman laate ya jhutlate?'
85: Aur un par azaab aa padega, Allah ka inkaar karne aur Us ki aayaton ko jhutlane ki wajah se. Aur woh apna bachaav karne ke liye bol nahin sakenge, apni be-bassi aur apni dalilon ke jhoote hone ki wajah se.
86: Kya dobara zinda hone ko jhutlane wale yeh log nahin dekhte ke Maine raat banayi taake woh us mein neend se aaram karein, aur Maine din ko un ke liye roshan banaya taake woh us mein dekhein aur phir apne kaam ki taraf doorein? Is baar baar ki maut aur us ke baad uthne mein maut ke baad dobara zinda hone ke suboot hain.
87: Aey Rasool, woh din yaad kijiye jab soor phoonkne par muqarrar farishta doosri baar phoonkega, phir aasmaano ke sab log aur zameen ke sab log dehshat-zada ho jayenge, siwaye un ke jinhein Allah ne apne fazl se is dehshat se bacha liya. Aur Allah ki saari makhlooq us din Us ke paas aayegi, itaat ke saath aur aajizi se.
88: Aur tum us din pahaadon ko dekhoge aur samjhoge ke woh jame hue hain aur hilte nahin, halanke woh haqeeqat mein is tarah chalenge jaise baadal chalte hain. Yeh Allah ka kaam hai, kyunke Wohi unhein chalata hai. Woh tumhare aamaal se khoob khabardar hai. Tumhara koi amal Us se chhipa nahin aur Woh tumhein un ka badla dega.
89: Qayamat ke din jo shaks iman aur neik aamaal le kar aayega use Jannat milegi aur woh us din ki haulnaakiyon se mehfooz rahega, Allah ke is aman dene ki wajah se.
90: Aur jo shaks kufr aur gunah le kar aayega, us ke liye Jahannam ki aag hai jis mein use munh ke bal daala jayega. Aur use daantte aur zaleel karte hue kaha jayega: 'Kya tumhein us kufr aur un gunahon ke siwa kisi aur cheez ka badla diya ja raha hai jo tum karte the?'
91: Aey Rasool, un se keh dijiye: 'Mujhe to sirf yeh hukm diya gaya hai ke main is shehar, yani Makkah ke Rubb ki ibadat karoon jise Us ne hurmat wala banaya, lihaza us mein koi khoon na bahaya jaye, us mein kisi par zulm na kiya jaye, us ka shikaar na kiya jaye aur us ke darakht na kaate jayein. Aur har cheez ki baadshahat Usi ki hai. Aur mujhe yeh bhi hukm diya gaya hai ke main un logon mein se ho jaoon jo Allah ke saamne Us ki itaat mein jhukte hain.'
92: 'Aur mujhe hukm diya gaya hai ke main logon ko Quran padh kar sunaoon; phir jo shaks us se hidayat paaye aur us ki taaleem par amal kare, us ki hidayat usi ko faida degi. Magar jo us ki taaleem se hat jaye, use rad kare aur us par amal na kare, to us se keh dijiye: main to sirf daraane walon mein se hoon; main tumhein Allah ke azaab se daraata hoon, aur tumhari hidayat mere haath mein nahin.'
93: Aey Rasool, keh dijiye: 'Tamam taarif Allah ke liye hai Us ki be-shumaar naimaton par. Woh tumhein kaaynat mein aur khud tumhare andar apni nishaniyan dikhayega; tum unhein pehchan loge is tarah ke woh tumhein haqq ke saamne jhukne par le aayengi. Aur aap ka Rubb tumhare aamaal se gaafil nahin; Woh unhein dekh raha hai, un mein se kuch Us se chhipa nahin aur Woh tumhein un ka badla dega.'
